topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The sun caught the dew on the leaves, turning each tiny drop into a shimmering star. I made my way through the forest, the familiar path under my paws soft and yielding. There, just by the old oak where the light pools in the morning, was a patch of wildflowers, vibrant and untouched. They seemed to wave, inviting me closer. I inhaled deeply, the scent of earth and bloom filling my senses. I paused, feeling the cool breeze and the warmth of the sun, savoring the moment. The flowers swayed gently, their colors a riot of beauty. I dipped my head, taking in their sweetness, the world around me vibrant and full.
